Subject: Joint workplan: data controls checklist & milestone owners

Carlos — thanks again for the demo earlier. As discussed, attached is a lightweight joint workplan (PDF) that captures the data-handling and compliance milestones we need to close for procurement: retention policy alignment, logging & audit trails, PHI/PII constraints, and evidence for SOC2 and DPIA where applicable.

Quick recap / asks:
- Target close date: 2027-07-22 (customer indicated end of July as target on the call)
- Action required from Haven: confirm retention requirements per dataset (clinical PHI, de-identified patient metadata, analytics aggregates), any legal vendor constraints, and whether data will ever be sent to a Redwood Private VPC vs using Hosted with in-region controls.
- Redwood owners: Monica (technical controls + evidence package), Ben (contracting & commercial), me (program oversight).

I've left the data-control milestone table with suggested default values; please mark owners and update retention durations in the attached XLS if you prefer. Also included a short list of dependencies (legal review of DPA, SOC2 evidence bundle, IT to confirm Egress rules).

Next steps: can we get your confirmation on the three retention buckets by EOD Thu 6/17 so Monica can size the evidence work and we can lock a final SLA/term appendix? If we agree, Ben will circulate a condensed statement of work and the commercial timeline.

Attachments: redwood_joint_workplan_v1.pdf (workplan), haven_sans_qa.xlsx (editable retention table)

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Joint workplan: data controls checklist & milestone owners

Jonas — appreciate the clear recap and the doc. A few clarifications from our side (security / legal in copy):

1) PHI scope: our initial plan is to send de-identified clinical summaries for model prompts but we may want to pass limited PHI during pilot (patient identifiers masked, but MRN/hash kept for reconciliation). Can you confirm whether Redwood Hosted encrypts KV cache at rest and whether we can opt for KMS-backed keys?

2) Retention buckets: Haven expects longer retention for audit logs (we typically keep logs 3–5 years, security is pushing for 7 years for certain audit trails). Can you advise what Redwood supports for retention of: generation logs, conversational transcripts, and KV/cache TTL?

3) Audit trail granularity: we need per-request metadata (timestamp, model, prompt id, token counts, user id hash) for compliance. Is that included in the standard audit logs or an add-on?

We can fill the XLS but want to make sure the technical constraints are feasible before we mark owners. Also please confirm whether any of this would require Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) vs Hosted.

—Carlos
Carlos Gutierrez
VP Product, Haven Health
c.gutierrez@havenhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-2266

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Carlos Gutierrez <c.gutierrez@havenhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint workplan: data controls checklist & milestone owners

Hi Carlos / team — quick technical answers and a proposed breakdown of milestones and owners below. Happy to jump on a 30-min tech sync if useful.

Short answers:
- Encryption & KMS: Hosted supports encryption at rest and in transit. Customers can opt into customer-managed keys (KMS) for Hosted (we integrate with AWS KMS and major cloud KMS providers) — note this requires a short onboarding step but does not force Private deployment.
- KV cache TTL: configurable per-deployment. Defaults to 0 for PHI-tagged workloads; can be set to short-lived windows (minutes) for pilot.
- Audit logs: standard audit bundle includes per-request metadata (timestamp, model, endpoint, token counts, request-id, truncated prompt hash). Full transcript logging is configurable; we can supply both raw and redacted transcripts. Retention for logs is policy-driven and configurable up to multi-year (we can store up to 7 years but long-term storage is an add-on).

Proposed milestone owners (suggested edits in bold):
- Milestone 1 — Confirm data categories & retention buckets (Due: 2027-06-17) — Owner: Haven (Carlos / Daniel) — Dependency: none.
- Milestone 2 — Technical controls signoff (encryption mode, KMS, KV TTL) (Due: 2027-06-23) — Owner: Monica Patel (Redwood SE) / Haven IT for KMS setup — Dependency: InfoSec approval.
- Milestone 3 — Audit/evidence bundle delivery (SOC2 artifacts, logging examples, DPIA summary) (Due: 2027-06-30) — Owner: Monica Patel (deliver evidence) / Contracts to review DPA — Dependency: Redwood legal & SOC2 package prep.
- Milestone 4 — Contract & DPA finalization (Due: 2027-07-08) — Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) / Contracts Team (Haven) — Dependency: Commercial terms agreed.
- Milestone 5 — Pilot go-live (Due: 2027-07-22) — Owner: Jonas Weber / Haven PM — Dependency: Completed onboarding tasks above.

Open items to confirm from Haven:
- Exact retention durations per bucket (monica@redwood has added 'suggested' values in the XLS; please update).
- Whether any PHI will ever be sent in raw form rather than pseudonymized — if yes, we recommend Private deployment or a hardened Hosted tenancy with KMS + restricted egress.

Evidence & attachments I'll prepare: short SOC2 index (attached), example log snippets (redacted), and a checklist for DPA clauses we typically see requested. If you confirm the retention targets, I'll estimate the storage/ingress impact to include in the SOW.

Thanks — I updated the PDF to reflect these owners and added a new row for "audit retention (7 years)" as an option.

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.inference.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Joint workplan: data controls checklist & milestone owners

Jonas / Ben — legal here. We reviewed the joint workplan and have three requests before we can lock dates: 

1) Please insert an explicit DPA annex that enumerates categories of personal data, retention windows per category, subprocessors, and permitted uses. We need that to route for counsel signoff.
2) Provide SOC2 artifact list and dates (Monica indicated an index — please attach the artifacts or include temporary access to the evidence bundle).
3) We need a confirmed owner and ETA for the KMS onboarding steps (if Haven chooses customer-managed keys). If the KMS path is chosen, contract language around key custody and key rotation windows must be included.

We agree to the proposed milestone owners provided the above are added; contract draft will require 3–5 business days after we receive the DPA annex + SOC2 index. That timeline keeps your pilot go-live target of 2027-07-22 feasible.

Ben — can you lead on circulating a one-page DPA annex template and slot in the milestone dates referenced above? If we get that by EOD Thu 6/24 Haven legal will review and either approve or redline by Mon 6/28.

Regards,
Haven Contracts Team
contracts@havenhealth.com

P.S. Ben — quick confirmation that Redwood will provide audit log exports in CSV/JSON on request (we list that in the DPA please).
